cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Pick the Prize
cards.instruction: Make them choose which reward, principle, or relationship matters most when not everything can be kept.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Choose the trophy ceremony or our anniversary dinner. Both start at seven, and the restaurant won't hold our table. I taught you to check a diary before promising me an evening.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A plan with a time in it, at least. But afterward loses the table. Are you keeping your promise to me or collecting the trophy?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then promise to leave before your name is called if that's what dinner takes. No 'might', like I used to tell you: which evening are you choosing?

reason: Make prior instruction affect the present exact Drive, and give each A turn a needed response from B. State incompatibility and disadvantage concretely; keep deliberate character concealment distinct from missing author context.
